results.title: Backend favorability computation removed (not just hidden)

steps.title: Given the AI Citation Sources section is rendering
When the network response for the domain list API call is inspected
Then the domain DTO does not include any favorability field (no favorable/unfavorable/mixed/sentiment property)

results.notes: API endpoint captured: GET /geo/api/v1/reports/.../overview/citation-sources [200]. Domain DTO keys: ['domain', 'sourceType', 'frequency', 'citedBy', 'visibilityGaps', 'competitiveLosses', 'sentimentIssues', 'llmCitations', 'citedUrls']. No 'favorable', 'unfavorable', 'mixed', or 'favorability' field found (favKeys=[]). HOWEVER: 'sentimentIssues' field IS present with sentimentScore values (e.g., {conceptName: 'Service après-vente', sentimentScore: -0.61, questionText: '...', providerKey: 'perplexity'}). Whether 'sentimentIssues' is the legacy Favorability field renamed/restructured or a distinct unrelated feature cannot be confirmed via network inspection alone — requires backend knowledge. Marking PARTIAL: explicit favorability labels removed, but sentiment scoring data persists in DTO.
